instruction: Edit /home/user/Desktop/task-005_initial.scad to make one watertight CSG three-axis, six-port pipe manifold (all dimensions in mm). Union four outer solids: a 120 x 70 x 8 flange box spanning x=-60..60, y=-35..35, z=0..8; a Z pipe on x=0, y=0 spanning z=0..50 (OD 40, ID 20); an X pipe on y=0, z=25 spanning x=-60..60 (OD 22, ID 12); and a Y pipe on x=0, z=25 spanning y=-35..35 (OD 16, ID 8). Subtract each pipe's coaxial through-bore so all three bores meet as one internal passage. The six open flow ports are at z=0/50, x=-60/60, and y=-35/35. Subtract four 5 diameter Z-axis bolt holes through z=0..8 at (x,y)=(-28,-18), (-28,18), (28,-18), and (28,18). The final envelope must be exactly 120 x 70 x 50. Fully render and export only /home/user/Desktop/task-005_output.stl; create no other output.
